question: Compare movement-slip retention at Serevin Seed Library and signed-calibration-record retention at Avrel Bell Workshop, including both hold and claim exceptions.
answer:
[1] Keep movement slips for 17 months. While a seed-quarantine hold is open, retain affected slips until the hold is released.

[2] Signed calibration records are retained for 4 years. An unresolved material claim extends retention of affected records until the claim is settled.
